tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated to the Magento admin Transactions grid, authenticated, closed an informational popup that blocks the filter row, filled all grid filters (Order ID/increment_id, Transaction ID/txn_id, Transaction Type/txn_type, Is Closed, Created At from/to), clicked Search, and observed the results (no records found). Stable, attribute-based selectors were recorded for each control and element hashes captured for deterministic interaction.

Task Definition:
- Provide a reusable automation tool that navigates to the Transactions grid, sets the provided filter values, applies the filters, and returns the grid results and a basic verification that each used selector resolves uniquely.

Action Plan:
1) Navigate to the provided transactions_url.
2) Wait for the page and grid to load.
3) Close the incoming message popup (recorded elementHash) to unblock filter inputs.
4) Fill the filter controls (order id, txn id, txn_type, is_closed, created_at from/to) using the recorded attribute-based selectors scoped to the grid when provided.
5) Click the recorded Search button selector.
6) Wait for the grid to reload and extract grid rows, no-records message and counts for each primary selector used.

Variable Identification (inputs):
- transactions_url (required): target admin grid URL recorded in the session.
- scope_selector (optional): CSS scope to prefix selectors (helps if multiple grids present).
- increment_id (optional): order id for filter, maps to input[name='increment_id'].
- txn_id (optional): transaction id for filter, maps to input[name='txn_id'].
- txn_type (optional): transaction type visible text to choose; maps to select[name='txn_type'].
- is_closed (optional): visible text (Yes/No) or '0'/'1' to choose; maps to select[name='is_closed'].
- created_at_from, created_at_to (optional): dates in YYYY-MM-DD format for created_at range.

Step Optimization:
- Use direct navigation instead of navigating through menus.
- Use stable attribute-based selectors (name attributes) scoped to the grid ('table.grid' or provided scope_selector) to avoid collisions. These were validated during the recorded session.
- Close the popup deterministically via the recorded elementHash (df76c6ce85) because it blocks interactions; this avoids intermittent failures.
- Include short waits after navigation, popup close and after clicking Search to let JS-driven grids finish rendering. Avoid index-based element addressing; prefer name-based selectors discovered during recording.

Notes / Caveats:
- The tool assumes an authenticated admin session is available. The recorded session authenticated before running these steps; authentication is intentionally omitted here.
- If selectors differ on a different Magento install (custom admin theme or localization), pass a scope_selector that uniquely identifies the transactions grid or update the selectors accordingly.
- The tool always writes the provided values into the filter inputs (empty string is allowed to clear a field). It does not branch conditionally based on emptiness to keep the execution deterministic.
name: search_transactions_grid
description: Navigate to the Magento admin Transactions grid, set filter values (order id, transaction id, transaction type, is_closed, created_at range) and run Search. Uses the stable selectors recorded during a demonstration on http://dockerized-magento.local. Returns the grid results and a short verification that each selector resolves uniquely.

steps.description: Open the Transactions grid page using the provided admin URL.
Wait for the page and any grid JavaScript to load.
Close the incoming message / popup that can block the filter row (recorded elementHash 'df76c6ce85'). This click is deterministic in the recorded session and unblocks the grid.
Wait briefly after closing the popup for the DOM to stabilize.
Type the Order ID (increment_id) into the Order ID filter input. Uses the recorded selector input[name='increment_id'] (elementHash from demonstration).
Type the Transaction ID into the Transaction ID filter input (maps to input[name='txn_id']).
Set the Transaction Type dropdown to the requested visible text (maps to select[name='txn_type']).
Set the Is Closed dropdown (Yes/No) (maps to select[name='is_closed']).
Set the Created At 'from' date input (maps to input[name='created_at[from]']).
Set the Created At 'to' date input (maps to input[name='created_at[to]']).
Click the Search button to apply filters (recorded selector: button[title='Search']).
Wait for the grid to reload after applying filters.
Capture the grid results and verification metadata. The extractor should return found rows (or 'No records found') and counts for each primary selector used by the tool.
steps.goal: Extract the Transactions grid rows, the 'No records found' message or table rows, and the total-records text. Also verify selector uniqueness by reporting the number of elements matching each primary selector.

input_schema.name: transactions_url
input_schema.description: Full URL of the Magento admin Transactions grid (e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'). The recorded run used this exact URL; keep this value unless your admin path differs.

input_schema.name: scope_selector
input_schema.description: CSS selector to scope the grid (optional). Example: 'table.grid' or '#sales_transactions_grid'. If provided, the tool will prefix field selectors with this scope to avoid collisions with other grids.

input_schema.name: increment_id
input_schema.description: Order ID / increment_id to filter by (maps to input[name='increment_id']). Leave empty string to not filter this field.

input_schema.name: txn_id
input_schema.description: Transaction ID to filter by (maps to input[name='txn_id']). Leave empty string to not filter this field.

input_schema.name: txn_type
input_schema.description: Transaction type visible text to select in the Transaction Type dropdown (examples: 'Order', 'Authorization', 'Capture', 'Void', 'Refund'). Maps to select[name='txn_type'].

input_schema.name: is_closed
input_schema.description: Is Closed value to select (examples: 'Yes', 'No' or values '1'/'0' depending on the admin). Maps to select[name='is_closed'].

input_schema.name: created_at_from
input_schema.description: Created At start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (maps to input[name='created_at[from]']). Leave empty to not set.

input_schema.name: created_at_to
input_schema.description: Created At end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (maps to input[name='created_at[to]']). Leave empty to not set.
